claims.observation: The Ua helper used by the builders serializes community-preset attribution.
claims.limitation: This helper does not reveal server-side preprocessing.

claims.observation: The final object serializer whitelists resolution, attribution, batch size, optional width/height, role/id/type media, optional prompt and folder. No explicit mask or inference checkpoint field is serialized here.
claims.limitation: A server can derive masks or conditioning from the referenced media. This is the inspected client path, not every endpoint.

claims.observation: The final motion serializer sends reference asset IDs, prompt, resolution, aspect ratio, optional dimensions, scene mode and selected character asset ID. It does not send a generated first frame, skeleton or explicit model checkpoint.
claims.limitation: The referenced assets and server processing remain opaque.

claims.observation: The motion validator distinguishes scene modes, permits at most one location role, checks the selected character belongs to the image references, and rejects duplicate media IDs.
claims.limitation: Static client validation is not proof of server enforcement or exact scene-mode model behavior.

claims.observation: Motion submission wraps the serialized params with free-generation flags and client metadata, then selects the motion job type.
claims.limitation: No generation was submitted during this investigation; these flags alone do not guarantee a free job.

claims.observation: The shared client transport posts JSON to /jobs/v2/{jobType}, with token-derived headers and an optional workspace header.
claims.limitation: This is static transport recovery, not a captured generation request.

claims.observation: The inspected production gateway base is https://fnf-api-gw.higgsfield.ai/fnf.
claims.limitation: An endpoint hostname does not identify its model provider. No direct authenticated endpoint calls were made.

claims.observation: The optional browser crop path draws decoded frames into a crop-sized canvas and exports AVC MP4; it can skip unchanged local files and attempts to retain audio.
claims.limitation: The exporter is lazy-loaded. This does not establish that the retained completed job used it, and does not identify server preprocessing.

claims.observation: Client duration validation combines the original minimum check with a normalized duration maximum check.
claims.limitation: The imported normalizer floors duration with epsilon 0.01 in this build. Do not equate this with an API trimming rule.

source_map_scan.limitation: Only retained files were scanned. Unlinked maps were not guessed or requested.

decision: Client contract recovered further; server inference source, weights and training remain unidentified. No model substitution or quality improvement is established by this investigation.
